_meta.scenario: Customer voluntarily cancels the trip. Since the requestor is the customer (or admin acting on behalf), the service auto-derives cancellation_sub_status as 'customer_cancelled'. No refund is triggered because it is customer-initiated.
_meta.note: canceled_by_cabbo = false → no refund triggered. If requesting user is the trip creator, sub-status is auto-set to customer_cancelled.

reason: Customer requested cancellation. Change of plans.

cancelation_detail.reason: Customer called to cancel. They mentioned a change in travel plans.
